const shape = new THREE.Shape();

shape.lineTo(w/2,-h/2);
shape.lineTo(w/2,h/2);

 const x = w/2 - (i+0.5)*pitch; // positions
 shape.lineTo(x,h/2);
 shape.lineTo(x, h/2-notchDepth);
 shape.lineTo(x+notchWidth,h/2-notchDepth);
 shape.lineTo(x+notchWidth,h/2);
}
shape.lineTo(-w/2,h/2);
shape.closePath();
But after last notch, cursor remains x+notchWidth; then line to -w/2. Need update xCursor? The shape line sequence after notch ends at x+width, top. At end set xCursor=-w/2. So:
shape.lineTo(x,h/2); ...; shape.lineTo(x+notchWidth,h/2); xCursor=x+notchWidth;
then after loop lineTo(-w/2,h/2). Good.

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    const container = document.getElementById("scene");
    const loading = document.getElementById("loading");
    const shelfButton = document.getElementById("shelf-button");
    const resetButton = document.getElementById("reset-button");
    const status = document.getElementById("status");
    const statusText = document.getElementById("status-text");

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer, scene, and lighting
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xe8e4db);
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0xe8e4db, 11, 24);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      38,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      50
    );

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      antialias: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.05;
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    renderer.domElement.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      "Interactive three-dimensional folding clothes drying rack"
    );
    container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    const hemisphere = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff8ed, 0x7a817e, 2.1);
    scene.add(hemisphere);

    const keyLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff1d9, 4.2);
    keyLight.position.set(4.5, 8, 5.5);
    keyLight.castShadow = true;
    keyLight.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    keyLight.shadow.camera.left = -6;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.right = 6;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.top = 7;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -3;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.near = 0.5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.far = 20;
    keyLight.shadow.bias = -0.0004;
    keyLight.shadow.normalBias = 0.025;
    scene.add(keyLight);

    const fillLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xdce8ee, 1.4);
    fillLight.position.set(-5, 4, -4);
    scene.add(fillLight);

    const floor = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(30, 30),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xd9d5cc,
        roughness: 0.96,
        metalness: 0
      })
    );
    floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    floor.position.y = -0.01;
    floor.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(floor);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Procedural wood texture
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    function createWoodTexture() {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = 512;
      canvas.height = 512;

      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
      context.fillStyle = "#b87d49";
      context.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      let seed = 9182;
      const random = () => {
        seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647;
        return (seed - 1) / 2147483646;
      };

      for (let i = 0; i < 210; i++) {
        const y = random() * canvas.height;
        const amplitude = 1 + random() * 7;
        const frequency = 0.008 + random() * 0.018;
        const phase = random() * Math.PI * 2;

        context.beginPath();
        context.moveTo(-10, y);

        for (let x = 0; x <= canvas.width + 10; x += 12) {
          const wave =
            Math.sin(x * frequency + phase) * amplitude +
            Math.sin(x * frequency * 2.3 + phase) * amplitude * 0.25;
          context.lineTo(x, y + wave);
        }

        context.strokeStyle = `rgba(78, 40, 18, ${0.035 + random() * 0.11})`;
        context.lineWidth = 0.5 + random() * 1.8;
        context.stroke();
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
        const x = random() * canvas.width;
        const y = random() * canvas.height;

        context.beginPath();
        context.ellipse(
          x,
          y,
          12 + random() * 45,
          1 + random() * 3,
          random() * Math.PI,
          0,
          Math.PI * 2
        );
        context.strokeStyle = "rgba(83, 44, 20, 0.08)";
        context.lineWidth = 1;
        context.stroke();
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(1.35, 1.35);
      texture.anisotropy = Math.min(
        8,
        renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy()
      );

      return texture;
    }

    const woodTexture = createWoodTexture();

    const woodMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      map: woodTexture,
      color: 0xffffff,
      roughness: 0.73,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const darkWoodMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      map: woodTexture,
      color: 0xc3a27c,
      roughness: 0.8,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const endWoodMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      map: woodTexture,
      color: 0x9e744d,
      roughness: 0.82,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const metalMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x687178,
      roughness: 0.28,
      metalness: 0.88
    });

    const brightMetalMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xaeb7bb,
      roughness: 0.22,
      metalness: 0.92
    });

    const rack = new THREE.Group();
    scene.add(rack);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // A-frame side supports
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const topY = 4.55;
    const bottomY = 0.2;
    const halfWidth = 1.55;
    const topZ = 0;
    const bottomZ = 0.9;

    function addAFrameLeg(x, bottomZ) {
      const topZ = -bottomZ;
      const topY = 4.48;
      const bottomY = 0.2;

      const length = Math.hypot(
        topY - bottomY,
        topZ - bottomZ
      );

      const leg = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.14, length, 0.18),
        woodMaterial
      );

      leg.position.set(
        x,
        (topY + bottomY) * 0.5,
        (topZ + bottomZ) * 0.5
      );

      // Local Y is aligned with the downward, outward leg vector.
      leg.rotation.x = Math.atan2(
        bottomZ - topZ,
        bottomY - topY
      );

      leg.castShadow = true;
      leg.receiveShadow = true;
      rack.add(leg);

      const foot = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.19, 0.12, 0.25),
        endWoodMaterial
      );

      foot.position.set(x, 0.06, bottomZ);
      foot.castShadow = true;
      foot.receiveShadow = true;
      rack.add(foot);
    }

    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      const x = side * halfWidth;

      const crossbar = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(3.5, 0.18, 0.2),
        woodMaterial
      );

      crossbar.position.set(x, topY, 0);
      crossbar.castShadow = true;
      crossbar.receiveShadow = true;
      rack.add(crossbar);

      addAFrameLeg(x, bottomZ);
    }

    // Small top connector blocks make the A-frames read clearly.
    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      const connector = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.22, 0.2, 0.34),
        darkWoodMaterial
      );

      connector.position.set(side * halfWidth, 4.49, 0);
      connector.castShadow = true;
      connector.receiveShadow = true;
      rack.add(connector);
    }

    // Visible screw heads on the front and back of the top crossbar.
    const screwGeometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
      0.025,
      0.025,
      0.018,
      14
    );

    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      for (const z of [-0.09, 0.09]) {
        const screw = new THREE.Mesh(screwGeometry, brightMetalMaterial);
        screw.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;
        screw.position.set(side * 1.756, topY, z);
        screw.castShadow = true;
        rack.add(screw);
      }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Notched drying rails
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    function createNotchedRailGeometry() {
      const width = 3.52;
      const height = 0.13;
      const thickness = 0.105;
      const notchCount = 4;
      const notchWidth = 0.055;
      const notchDepth = 0.045;

      const shape = new THREE.Shape();

      shape.moveTo(-width / 2, -height / 2);
      shape.lineTo(width / 2, -height / 2);
      shape.lineTo(width / 2, height / 2);

      let cursor = width / 2;

      for (let i = 0; i < notchCount; i++) {
        const notchX = width / 2 - (i + 0.5) * (width / notchCount);

        shape.lineTo(notchX, height / 2);
        shape.lineTo(notchX, height / 2 - notchDepth);
        shape.lineTo(notchX + notchWidth, height / 2 - notchDepth);
        shape.lineTo(notchX + notchWidth, height / 2);

        cursor = notchX + notchWidth;
      }

      shape.lineTo(-width / 2, height / 2);
      shape.closePath();

      const geometry = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape, {
        depth: thickness,
        steps: 1,
        bevelEnabled: true,
        bevelSegments: 3,
        bevelSize: 0.022,
        bevelThickness: 0.022,
        curveSegments: 8
      });

      // Extrusion local Z becomes the rail's world X axis.
      geometry.rotateY(Math.PI / 2);
      geometry.translate(-thickness / 2, 0, 0);
      geometry.computeVertexNormals();

      return geometry;
    }

    const railGeometry = createNotchedRailGeometry();
    const railHeights = [2.38, 3.28, 4.18];

    for (const y of railHeights) {
      const rail = new THREE.Mesh(railGeometry, woodMaterial);
      rail.position.y = y;
      rail.castShadow = true;
      rail.receiveShadow = true;
      rack.add(rail);

      // Dark strips at the bottom of each notch emphasize the cutout depth.
      const notchCount = 4;
      const notchWidth = 0.055;
      const notchDepth = 0.045;

      for (let i = 0; i < notchCount; i++) {
        const notchX =
          1.76 - (i + 0.5) * (3.52 / notchCount);

        const lining = new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.BoxGeometry(
            notchWidth + 0.012,
            0.008,
            0.018
          ),
